column1: #  - a predicate is a function named by its functor without the arity (area, not area/2); its clauses, facts and rules, are one symbol when they are consecutive and have the same arity, listed at the first clause: shape/1 (lines 8-10), area/2 (20-26) and name//0 (36-37) are one symbol each;
#  - the same name with a different arity is a separate symbol (describe/1 at 31, describe/2 at 32);
#  - clauses of one predicate separated by another predicate are separate symbols (alpha at 51 and 53);
#  - a DCG rule (greeting --> ...) is a predicate; zero-arity predicates (ready, halt_check) are predicates;
#  - other directives (use_module, dynamic, discontiguous, initialization) and the goals in a body are not definitions.
